# Trendi

> A crawl-readiness reference for tools that may read this file. It is not a ranking, citation or AI-visibility mechanism.

Trendi is operated by TRENDI LIMITED, New Zealand. We provide Concierge customer-enquiry and office assistance alongside done-for-you SEO and AI visibility for businesses worldwide. Concierge includes website chat and configured phone/voice, email, SMS, booking, follow-up and approval-controlled social posting workflows; provider-dependent channels require setup and testing. Concierge is USD $199 a month with a 3-month minimum; it is set up around each customer's own contact details and CRM. We do not guarantee leads, sales, rankings, traffic, citations or AI mentions.

Indexed: search engines can reach, read and store pages. Found: pages are easier to find for customer searches. Mentioned: accurate information on sources AI tools draw from. Mentions and links are reported separately.

Concierge is USD $199 per month, with a three-month minimum, then month to month. The price includes everything in the Concierge offer: full setup and testing, a dedicated business phone number, voice answering, SMS and email confirmations, voicemail, CRM, integrations and social posting, with no extras. SEO and AI visibility and penetration testing are separate products, priced separately. The SEO and AI visibility service is USD $499 per month, with a three-month minimum, then month to month. An alternative USD $499 deposit secures a start date and is credited against the first invoice. Prices are in USD. NZ customers: 15% GST included (not added on top). Outside NZ: 0% GST.
